description: List facts whose knowledge interval opened since a timestamp: new periods from fresh filings and restatements of earlier periods. Each item has the company, the concept_id, the version number (1 for a first report, higher for a restatement) and the new value object with its period, known interval, restated flag and proof. This is the pull twin of the financial_data_updated webhook: poll it to keep a model, a cache or a watchlist current, or scope it to one company to see what changed in its history. Cursor paging via data.next_cursor.

company.description: Optional: only changes for this company.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page (data.next_cursor).

limit.description: Maximum number of periods or items to return (default 100, at most 1000).

since.description: Return changes known since this instant (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC 3339 timestamp).

name: changes_since

outputSchema.description: The FinancialMD envelope (docs/API.md section 2): data plus meta (request_id, as_of knowledge time, matched company, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base). Every numeric value inside data is an object with value, unit, currency, period, known interval, restated flag, method and a proof pointing at the filing. On failure the result is isError with an error object instead.

data.description: { items: [{ company { fmd_id, cik, name }, concept_id, version, value (value object with period, known, restated, proof) }], next_cursor }.

error.description: Present only on isError results: the API error code and message plus remedy hints.

meta.description: Request metadata: request_id, as_of, company resolution, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base.

attribution.description: Citations a source requires on anything shown from the answer.

title: What changed since a time
